archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO x CINEMATIC STADIUM
target_audience: Tech recruiters, engineering leaders, creative directors, sports-tech founders
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Synthesize UEFA Champions League broadcast graphics, Swiss typography, and high-performance WebGL interactive canvas
Emotion First: Feel the surge of tunnel entry, floodlights igniting, and stadium crowd roar through visual rhythm
Content is King: Present software engineering achievements as match stats, trophy cabinets, and tactical formations
Zoom In: Intimate macro close-ups of pitch textures, glowing jersey squad number 03, and high-contrast tactical heatmaps
Negative Space: Deep stadium black voids (#06090E) with precise lime pitch lines to spotlight high-value metrics

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none
hierarchy.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight

layout_strategies.spacing_scale: Use 2x-3x generous spacing. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding p-6 or p-8
layout_strategies.hero_section: Asymmetrical split with giant squad number '03' watermark in backdrop (text-[18vw]), stadium spotlight gradient overlay, live match timer widget, player archetype tags
layout_strategies.bento_grid: Mode B High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 for match statistics, career progression, and radar charts
layout_strategies.tactical_formation_section: Interactive 4-3-3 pitch layout mapping technical skills (React, Node, Python, Three.js) into player positions with hover heatmaps

header_nav.classes: fixed top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 w-[92%] max-w-6xl rounded-full bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 px-6 py-3 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]
elements: Nav Links (Overview, Fixtures, Tactics, Stats, Contact)

cards.classes: bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-emerald-500/50 hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(16,185,129,0.15)] transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,197,94,0.4)] active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-700/80 text-white border border-white/10 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-all duration-200 hover:border-white/30

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll enabled for cinematic fluidity
motion_and_interactions.framer_motion: Staggered entrance for stat counters, pitch line draw-in animations on scroll, 3D tilt effect on player card
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Interactive goal mini-game in CTA section, tactical draw lines on hover over project cards, interactive rating radar

accessibility_and_testing.wcag_compliance: Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for all body text over dark background
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components MUST include semantic kebab-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a cinematic, full-screen football-themed portfolio for Saish Bhujbal (Squad #03).
Ensure dark mode by default with stadium spotlights, neon green turf accents, and pitch line motifs.

Include sections: Hero match entrance, EA Sports style FIFA rating player card, Tactical formation skill tree, Featured projects as highlight reels, Pitchside testimonials, and Transfer window inquiry form.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, cards, and inputs.
Do NOT use generic Inter font for headings; use uppercase Barlow Condensed or Bebas Neue.
